library.kw_066:r_74249bc0355588eb.text:
A private security company whose majority shareholder is the $$ＵＮ$$ Security Force.
Headquartered in Odaiba, Tokyo, with Denjiro $$大河内$$ serving as president.
Its original business was the management and operation of $$ダイ・ガード$$, developed to counter $$ヘテロダイン$$, but since $$ヘテロダイン$$ did not appear for twelve years, the company expanded into general security services, while the divisions related to $$ダイ・ガード$$ tended to shrink instead.
$$ダイ・ガード$$'s operation is handled by Public Relations Section 2, headed by Section Chief $$大杉$$.

library.kw_066:r_66f57d75a8cbc1c9.text:
Refers to planets that were transposed into the solar system by the $$大時空震動$$ and the Spacequakes that followed it.
They are scattered between the outer reaches of the Earth $$スフィア$$ and Jupiter, but few of them are habitable. The peoples who live on them are very small in number and possess their own unique cultures and civilizations, but since they take a stance of mutual non-interference with Earth, their existence is effectively ignored.

library.kw_066:r_0999a88a9cd4ab8a.text:
A category within "Battling," the wagering matches in which ATs fight each other, in which firearms and live ammunition are used.
The competitors risk their lives, and their pay is correspondingly high. Also, the tension of a serious contest, combined with the thrill of stray bullets flying into the audience seats, runs high among spectators, and large sums of money change hands.

library.kw_066:r_1bf3aa9ffc62c073.text:
A modified soldier developed by $$マーティアル$$.
Cyborg surgery has been performed over the entire body, and additionally a control system called an auxiliary brain has been installed. Because this auxiliary brain governs combat ability, it resolves the emotional problems that were a weakness even of $$ＰＳ$$ (Perfect Soldiers).
Cardinal $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ modified his daughter $$テイタニア$$, who had been in an accident, into a $$ネクスタント$$, intending to use her combat power, which exceeded even that of a $$ＰＳ$$, to eliminate "the Untouchable One," $$キリコ$$.

library.kw_066:r_85c7a9f03be38c7b.text:
A pan-galactic religious society whose doctrine holds that "conflict is the principle governing all things."
It is widely worshipped across both the Gilgamesh and Balarant factions. Among military personnel in particular, one's battle achievements translate directly into rank within $$マーティアル$$, and it has numerous devout believers.
The one who unites it all is the $$法皇$$, who wields great power.

library.kw_066:r_aa110ab44d20db3b.text:
A pan-galactic religious society whose doctrine holds that "conflict is the principle governing all things."
It is widely worshipped across both the Gilgamesh and Balarant factions. Among military personnel in particular, one's battle achievements translate directly into rank within $$マーティアル$$, and it has numerous devout believers.
The one who unites it all is the $$法皇$$, who wields great power.
Regarding $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, who bowed to no one and even did away with Wiseman, it had been decided that he would be recognized as "the Untouchable One" and left alone. However, Cardinal $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$, to bolster his standing in the upcoming election for $$法皇$$, ordered his daughter $$テイタニア$$ to assassinate $$キリコ$$, and this became the incident that triggered the collapse of $$マーティアル$$'s authority.

library.kw_066:r_11ee779a12307e2f.text:
An artificially enhanced soldier.
Also called a Perfect Soldier.
With their memories emptied, they are granted physical abilities and reflexes beyond those of ordinary people. Their combat ability is tremendous, far surpassing even veteran AT pilots, but they tend to be unstable mentally.
Additionally, as the price for their high abilities, it is said that they cannot maintain their bodies without periodically bathing in showers of Jijirium.
Gilgamesh, Balarant, and the $$秘密結社$$ each conduct research into it, and Balarant's $$ＰＳ$$ are notable for being enhanced through mechanical means.

library.kw_066:r_0ebb8ce68048aa81.text:
A mysterious organization operating covertly within the $$アストラギウス$$ Galaxy.
Its true nature is as the hands and feet of the psychic Wiseman, and it operated across both Gilgamesh and Balarant. However, when Wiseman chose $$キリコ・キュービィー$$ as his successor, and that same $$キリコ$$ did away with Wiseman, the organization collapsed.

library.kw_066:r_88303de7661f1423.text:
Melkia Strategic Armored Corps Special Duty Squad X-1.
A combat unit founded by Yoran Pailsen, in which every single member possesses combat ability worth a thousand men.
Loyal to their missions, their thoroughgoing, almost inhumane conduct - such as the annihilation operation on the planet Sansa - earned them the fearful nickname "the Bloodsucking Squad" from friend and foe alike.
After the war, the surviving members became the private soldiers of their founder Pailsen, but were wiped out in an attack by former squad members who had sworn revenge against him.

library.kw_066:r_f08dda1644853063.text:
A program that controls the movements of an AT, or the disc that stores it.
It automates actions and simplifies operation, and it can be said that the performance of the $$ミッションディスク$$ determines how an AT moves.
Pilots customize and use them as appropriate, according to their own preferences and the situation.

library.kw_066:r_039b9dee6745abe3.text:
A human who cannot die, born at a probability of one in 25 billion.
In addition to a physical recovery ability far beyond that of ordinary people, they possess something beyond mere luck that lets them avoid every circumstance that would otherwise cause death.
Those fascinated by this existence, after their research, at last became convinced that $$キリコ・キュービィー$$ was indeed an $$異能生存体$$.
Furthermore, it was because he possessed this ability that $$キリコ$$ was named the successor to the psychic Wiseman.

library.kw_066:r_af3a406d3739a581.text:
The Japan located on the southern side of the two Japanese archipelagos.
It became a colony of the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$, and its name of "Japan" was once taken from it, but with the reorganization of the Earth Federation, it newly gained the name "$$新日本$$."

library.kw_066:r_20d694d8c6c4937b.text:
A film depicting the battle 12,000 years ago between the $$堕天翅$$ tribe and those who piloted the Mythical Aquarion. Based on mythology, it is a love story themed around the love between $$アポロン$$, the reincarnation of a $$堕天翅$$ hero, and $$シルフィ$$.
Note that "Aqueria" refers to Aquarion itself.
Though the film itself is nothing special, the theme song sung by its lead actress $$アリシア$$, who played $$シルフィ$$, has been highly acclaimed.

library.kw_066:r_05391d823a640dfd.text:
A live project centered on the Galactic Fairy $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and the Super Dimension Cinderella, $$ランカ・リー$$.
Besides those two, various other artists are also scheduled to participate, and it is drawing attention from around the world.

library.kw_066:r_d999219cd54d2842.text:
Emaan's caravan that travels the world via the Groma.
Its leader is Shaia Toube.
$$桂木桂$$, who time-slipped from Earth twenty years ago, also belonged to it, and had a child with Mimsy Lars, whom he met there.
Over the singularity that was the key to $$時空修復$$, there was a period when they were pursued by both their home country of Emaan and its rival nation Chiram. In the end, however, they served as a bridge between the two and contributed greatly to the $$時空修復$$.

library.kw_066:r_4eaaa79892e5d399.text:
A device that generated the enormous $$時空震動$$ that destroyed the barrier between parallel worlds.
It was originally a weapon meant to forcibly transpose the surrounding space, but a runaway accident produced an effect beyond what was expected, giving birth to a multitude of worlds.
At the moment of activation, $$桂木桂$$ and $$オルソン・Ｄ・ヴェルヌ$$, who were present at the scene, became singularities, becoming the key to repairing the disordered spacetime.

library.kw_066:r_87cc3d7f1d05c874.text:
A small nation on the planet Melkia, which has adopted a monarchy.
It has a warm, humid climate with jungles, and its principal industry is agriculture.
Third Prince Kanjelman, who rebelled against the royal family's rush toward modernization, raised the Holy Kingdom of $$クメン$$, sparking a large-scale civil war, and the Kingdom of $$クメン$$'s side hired mercenaries. They were gathered at the base Assemble EX-10, and among them were $$ル・シャッコ$$ and $$キリコ・キュービィー$$.
The civil war in the Kingdom of $$クメン$$ ended without a victor, due to the intervention of the Melkian military.

library.kw_066:r_bf8f7b744563fa5d.text:
Former representative of the $$ＵＮ$$ Peacekeeping Council under the $$ＡＤＷ$$.
After the birth of the Earth Federation, his achievements led him to become Supreme Commander of the Earth Federation Forces.
During the $$破界事変$$, when he was representative of the Peacekeeping Council, he formed the special international rescue team "$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$," which acted beyond the bounds of organization and position for the peace and happiness of all humanity.
He possesses a strong will that does not hesitate at immediate sacrifice, but voices of suspicion were also raised over his forceful methods and his unreadable true intentions.
Also, though its truth is unconfirmed, records remain suggesting he has lived for over 200 years, and there are many mysteries surrounding him.
During the $$再世戦争$$, he fell into enemy hands and was held captive, but in the end, he gave up his life to entrust humanity's future to those who would carry on afterward.

library.kw_066:r_0a9804cc666f2f7b.text:
Former representative of the $$ＵＮ$$ Peacekeeping Council under the $$ＡＤＷ$$.
After the birth of the Earth Federation, his achievements led him to become Supreme Commander of the Earth Federation Forces.
During the $$破界事変$$, when he was representative of the Peacekeeping Council, he formed the special international rescue team "$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$," which acted beyond the bounds of organization and position for the peace and happiness of all humanity.
He possesses a strong will that does not hesitate at immediate sacrifice, but voices of suspicion were also raised over his forceful methods and his unreadable true intentions.
During the $$再世戦争$$, he fell into enemy hands and was held captive, but in the end, he gave up his life to entrust humanity's future to those who would carry on afterward.
His true identity was the same person, in a parallel world, as $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, who had touched the $$黒の英知$$, and he possessed both a long lifespan exceeding 200 years and limited, though restricted, knowledge concerning the future.

library.kw_066:r_566acff2ff34040e.text:
A collection of all knowledge from the past to the future, also called a Fragment of the Taiji.
Its true nature is unknown, and it is not even clear whether it is a concept or a physical object.
It is said that anyone who obtains it gains boundless wisdom, but at the price of coming to know a despairing future in which a fundamental catastrophe awaits.
$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$ is also one of those who touched the $$黒の英知$$, and it is presumed that the ability to control $$次元力$$ was obtained through it.

library.kw_066:r_c7d16d0dc93c780b.text:
The mastermind behind the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$.
He created Edel Bernal, the ringleader of Chimera and a brigadier general of the Earth Federation Forces, and controlled world affairs in order to play in a free world of his own desire.
He succeeded in a limited control of the Power of Origin ($$オリジン・ロー$$), and using that power, behaves however his desires lead him. His guiding principle is summed up in a single phrase: "As long as it's interesting!", and he enjoys the existence of the multitude of worlds born from the $$時空震動弾$$ more than anyone else.
Through his application of the Power of Origin, he has integrated the abilities of his multiple selves existing across parallel worlds, and surpasses ordinary people in every respect.
He is also freed from concepts such as ethics and morality, and since he is driven by desires that others find hard to understand, it is difficult to read his intentions or actions.
It is said that the process by which he unraveled the Power of Origin came about because $$エルガン・ローディック$$, the same person as him in a parallel world, touched the $$黒の英知$$.
His true form is a beautiful young man, but until the final battle he played the role of the ugly old scientist Jie Beibel.
Also, the name "$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$" is merely one of convenience, and his real name is something else.
